name: Glasha
source: An orc, and a very old friend of Roman's. Glasha is about as 'full-blooded' as orcs come north side of the sea. Her social skills are lacking at the best of times, but there's few problems which she can't fight, drink, or fuck her way out of, preferably in that order. Glasha and Roman share a mutual respect: Roman respects that Glasha could probably beat a bear in a fair fight, and Glasha respects Roman when he says it's a bad idea.
